sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. Parantap Singh, Advocate for the applicant.

Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, Deputy Advocate General for the
 State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

The applicant is in judicial custody in Fir No.80 of 2024, dated 02.07.2024, under Sections
376(2)(n), 376(3) Ipc and Sections 5/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act,
2012, Police Station Kathghodam, District Nainital.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
Learned State counsel gives a statement that the victim has been informed in the case.
4. According to the FIR, the informant came in contact with the applicant when she was studying in Class VIIth.
After 02-03 years of their friendship, they fell in love.
The applicant established physical relations on multiple occasions with the victim under the pretext of marriage.
The victim got pregnant, but the applicant facilitated her abortion.
The FIR is quite in detail.
It records that in the year 2023 and 2024 the applicant has declined to marry the victim.
He established physical relations with the victim, when she was 13 years of age.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the relations, as per the victim, was about 11 years back; the victim was 24 years of age, when she filed the FIR, which means, she has attended majority some 06 years back; she has not filed any application.
6. State to file objections within four weeks.
7. List this case on 26.03.2024.
